color.note: Product palette = app/src/ui/tokens.ts (light and dark), the same values the /painel dark dashboard uses. Marketing raw colors come from frontend/brand.css. Pink is the one brand color; green only means money gained.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground of every product screen. Text on it: ink, ink-muted (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card, grouped list, banner. Called plane 1 in the identity PDF.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Chip, segmented track, secondary button, input, composer, user chat bubble. Plane 2.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Segmented thumb, avatar, raised card, disabled send. Plane 3.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px ring on cards and the empty track of a progress bar. Decorative hairline only (1.2:1 on bg): no control or meaning depends on it alone. A pink progress fill on this track is about 2.9:1 in light, so the percentage is always written beside the bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-control and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and descriptions on bg, surface and surface-control.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, unselected segment label. 4.5:1 on surface-control in light (the closest pair).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: PigBank pink. Fills, icons, chart marks, the today marker. Never small text: use brand-ink. White on it is only 3.5:1, so text on a pink fill is on-action.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill and pink wash. Text on it: brand-ink.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Pink as text or link on bg, surface and brand-soft. Darker in light, lighter in dark so small type stays at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button. Pink is for a decision, not for decoration.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action. 5.1:1 on pink in both themes; white would give 3.5:1.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Money gained: income amounts, a positive delta, success status. Always with a + sign or a word too.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Spending above pace, invoice markers, warning banner icon.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The orange 'Saiu' bar in the calendar and the chart zero line. A data mark, not a message color.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, danger button fill, danger banner icon. 4.5:1 on bg and surface in light.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger. Dark theme lightens danger, so its label turns dark.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: /painel (dark) only: hairline between ledger rows, stat quadrants and the simulator footer. White at 7%, so it vanishes on a light ground: in the light theme use border.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: /painel (dark) only: hairline on hover and on floating layers.

tokens.name: pink-wash
tokens.usage: /painel (dark): fill of a selected or pressed state and the active nav item. brand-soft is the same wash composited on bg as a solid color.

tokens.name: pink-line
tokens.usage: /painel (dark): 1px inset stroke of a selected or pressed state, and the chart's today line.

tokens.name: pink-support
tokens.usage: Marketing only (landing, e-mail): soft pink panels and details. Not used in the product UI.

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: Marketing only: the lime of the Piggy hoodie cords, stickers and highlights. Product success is positive, never neon.

tokens.name: neon-ink
tokens.usage: Marketing: darker lime for text on a light ground. Source value kept exact, but it reaches only 2.9:1 on paper, so use it for text of 24px or more or for marks, never body copy. Small success text in the product is positive.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Marketing dark ground and text on neon.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Marketing light ground (off-white).

tokens.name: serie-1
tokens.usage: Goal series 1 (cyan) in the metas card. A data mark; the light value is darker so it stays visible on surface-control.

tokens.name: serie-2
tokens.usage: Goal series 2 (violet). Data mark.

tokens.name: serie-3
tokens.usage: Goal series 3 (blue). Data mark.

tokens.name: serie-4
tokens.usage: Goal series 4 (light fuchsia). Data mark.

tokens.name: cat-mercado
tokens.usage: Category hue: mercado. Same in both themes; names and amounts are always written, so hue never carries the meaning alone.

tokens.name: cat-delivery
tokens.usage: Category hue: delivery.

tokens.name: cat-transporte
tokens.usage: Category hue: transporte.

tokens.name: cat-lazer
tokens.usage: Category hue: lazer.

tokens.name: cat-assinaturas
tokens.usage: Category hue: assinaturas.

tokens.name: cat-compras
tokens.usage: Category hue: compras.

tokens.name: cat-moradia
tokens.usage: Category hue: moradia.

tokens.name: cat-outros
tokens.usage: Category hue: outros.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Spending-intensity ramp for the dark dashboard calendar, step 0 (no spending). Defined for dark grounds only; do not use on a light ground.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heat ramp step 1. Numerals on steps 1 to 3 are ink-muted.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heat ramp step 2.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heat ramp step 3.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heat ramp step 4. Numerals on steps 4 to 6 are white.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heat ramp step 5.

tokens.name: heat-6
tokens.usage: Heat ramp step 6, most spending.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one hero figure of a screen: the forecast balance. Numbers use tabular figures.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heading. Button labels also use this weight at 13px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Working size: row titles, widget titles, inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips, legends, axis, tab bar labels.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing hero headline (fs-5xl, Black: 'títulos de impacto'). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Landing section headline (fs-4xl). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Smaller landing headline (fs-3xl). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Landing subtitle (fs-2xl, Bold: 'subtítulos'). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: subtitle-sm
styles.usage: Card heading on the landing (fs-xl). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline (fs-lg). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: text
styles.usage: Landing body copy (fs-md). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Fine print and form help (fs-sm). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

styles.name: tiny
styles.usage: Legal and footer notes (fs-xs). Scale from frontend/brand.css; the pairing of weight and line height follows its comments (Black for impact titles, Bold for subtitles, tight 1.1, snug 1.25, normal 1.5).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its description, calendar cell gap.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked elements inside a card.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card top padding, banner padding, screen gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-huge
tokens.usage: Large breaks on welcome and empty screens.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Button, chip, segmented track and thumb. Larger than any height, so it cuts in half.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: Card, banner, Piggy strip.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The rest: small cards.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Input and grouped list.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Small tone chip (goal in the chat, pace %).

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Calendar heat cell.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Progress bar.

shadow.note: No shadow on a surface at rest. Depth is plane tone plus a 1px border.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised card in light only. In dark the plane tone does the lifting.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Marketing only: pink glow under a hero call to action. Never inside the product.
